newsitem.title: USA: Mcgraw-Hill's publishing unit's earnings up.
newsitem.headline: Mcgraw-Hill's publishing unit's earnings up.

text.p: McGraw-Hill Cos Inc Wednesday reported second-quarter earnings of $0.65 a share, compared with $0.57 a share, as operating profits in its educational publishing unit rose sharply.
The company's educational and professional publishing unit posted $34.2 million in operating profits, up 29.3 percent over last year.
In all, the company posted a net income of $65.2 million, or $0.65 a share, compared with a net of $57.2 million, or $0.57 a share, the year before.
An April 15 First Call consensus estimate of 10 brokers put the company's earnings at $0.61 a share.

The publishing unit posted $357.3 million in revenues, up 28.7 percent from $277.6 million last year. The company said the former Higher Education Group it acquired from Times Mirror Co for the company's Shepard's legal publishing business in October 1996 contributed $31 million in revenues.
McGraw said the education group's revenues offset the $17 million revenue Shepard posted in the second quarter of 1996.
